name: Local production preview
scope: Serves the current built site locally for browser validation.
safety: Read-only preview; no external deploy or credential access.
notes: Useful for layout, API and 3D smoke checks before any remote publish.

name: GitHub origin branch
scope: Keeps the single SEIS branch recoverable outside the machine once GitHub auth is ready.
safety: Push is blocked until GitHub CLI authentication is confirmed.
notes: Current flow intentionally stops when origin, branch cleanliness or gh auth is not ready.

name: Vercel preview deployment
scope: Preview or production deployment for emirhankudun.com after CLI/auth setup.
safety: Requires explicit user confirmation before deploy and does not store Vercel secrets in source.
notes: Ready by configuration; remains needs_credentials until Vercel auth/env is present.

name: Custom server handoff
scope: Copies a production build or static fallback to a selected external server.
safety: Never runs without a concrete host, path, auth method and separate confirmation.
notes: Prepared so the site does not get lost, but server credentials must stay outside git.

name: Static fallback archive
scope: Dependency-light HTML/CSS/JS version for emergency publishing and rollback.
safety: No build server required; can be hosted by any static file server.
notes: Preserves the portfolio story, Behance codes, runtime summary and contact route.
